== Published English Original Virtual Set 5 wording ==
The later wording replaces the optional attrition amount from an opposing starfighter’s printed power with +3 in battle while Dengar pilots. It grants less-than-4 immunity independent of Dengar. Capacity and printed ship statistics remain.
